# Public repository checks

## Public data and export policy

Use Administrator for exported user metadata and a repository-local neutral Git identity. Keep customer data and credentials private. Before resuming work after the history replacement, create a fresh clone and reapply unfinished changes as a reviewed patch. [Public repository privacy and export instructions](https://github.com/Dinext-pro/dinext-common/blob/main/.github/ci/PRIVACY.md).
